runs.notes: Glenn posted: "I've scheduled a special this Monday Nov 2 at 1:30 to the Pines if anyone wants to join let me know." Departure point and provider were not stated in the post. Peter Schwartz replied asking whether it is with Sayville Ferry, and said he might be interested in taking the return trip back. DJ Mike Borowski replied Nov 2 asking whether the special is still happening today and, if so, from where.
runs.subject: [Pines Winter Ferry] Special to Pines / Monday Nov 2 @ 1:30 PM

runs.connection: Arrives Ocean Bay Park by 11:50 AM; riders sign up via the headcount form at fippoa.org/election-day-lateral-service
runs.notes: Election Day lateral water taxi service (not a Sayville run). Confirmed Nov 1 by Chris Mai (FIPPOA): a lateral special with SFS from the Pines to Ocean Bay Park for Election Day.
runs.riders_note: Sign-ups are collected through the FIPPOA headcount form, not by email, so rider names aren't listed here.
runs.subject: [Pines Winter Ferry] 🚨Gauging Interest 🚨 2026 Election Day Lateral Water Taxi Service from The Pines to Ocean Bay Park 🗳️
